One of the refresh rates a display supports at a size, counted from the lowest. Rates that are the same after rounding to whole Hz are given once. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.
@param display  The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays).
@param width  The width in pixels of the size.
@param height  The height in pixels of the size.
@param index  The rate number, from 1 to [CountRefreshRates](CountRefreshRates).
@returns The refresh rate in Hz, or 0 if there is no such rate.
@gap A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
